items.item_text: cover letter
references
current NCCPA certification and PA licensure or eligibility for a PA licensure in California;
The successful candidate will have a Master's Degree from an ARC-PA accredited program or equivalent post PA-C Master’s degree;
strong commitment to student success and innovative education;
three years of full-time academic experience in a Physician Assistant/Associate Program;
relevant clinical experience;
demonstrated leadership and management experience;
knowledge of and experience with ARC-PA Standards;
demonstrated ability to work as a member of a team of highly motivated and experienced individuals;

Knowledgeable about and responsible for: - Program organization, - Program administration, - Fiscal management of the program, - Continuous programmatic review and analysis, - Program planning, - Program development, - Completion of ARC-PA required documents, and - Adherence to ARC-PA Standards and policies.
Enforce program policies and procedures.
Recruit and retain qualified faculty, staff and support personnel.
Provide effective leadership by exhibiting responsiveness to issues related to personnel, strong communication skills, and proactive problem-solving.
Support acquisition and maintenance of clinical sites.
Implement continuous programmatic and curricular outcomes assessment.
Lead annual review and revision of the program mission, vision, and goals as well as program competencies.
Ensure high-quality didactic and clinical instruction.
Support the Director of Didactic Education and the Director of Clinical Education with curriculum coordination and development.
Provide didactic instruction as able.
Participate in the academic advisement of students.
Ensure the availability of remedial instruction for students in collaboration with the Director of Didactic Education and the Director of Clinical Education.
Participate in student performance evaluation for didactic and clinical phase students in collaboration with the Director of Didactic Education and the Director of Clinical Education.
Oversee and participate in the admissions process.
Foster academic and clinical collaborations with other programs in the School of Health Sciences, the School of Pharmacy, and the Henry E. Riggs School of Applied Life Sciences.
Keep abreast of all issues impacting PA education and practice through ongoing clinical practice, maintenance of PA licensure and certification, and continuing medical education.
Carry regular faculty responsibilities related to teaching, service, research, and administration.
Engage in active scholarship.
Ability to inspire the program’s community and articulate a clear vision that showcases the program’s strengths while developing new levels of excellence.
Excellent oral and written communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with students, faculty, administrators, staff and external constituents.
Ability to handle multiple priorities with excellent organizational skills.
Honesty, integrity, and commitment to maintaining high professional standards.
Ability to build consensus and proactively manage conflicts.
Innovative and entrepreneurial.
Initiation, implementation, and management of MSPA program for the recruitment and admission of qualified students.
